ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The right figure is the “variation curve of river water temperature of the Yenisei River in a certain month”; the horizontal axis from left to right represents the upper reaches, middle reaches, and lower reaches, and the vertical axis is marked 5℃, 0℃, and -5℃, with the dashed line being 0℃. The curve is close to 0℃ near Jia in the upper reaches, rises above 0℃ and is relatively high near Yi; afterward it decreases toward the middle and lower reaches, and near Bing it approaches and changes from above 0℃ to below 0℃; by near Ding it is already clearly below 0℃. Reasoning: An ice flood is most likely to occur at the boundary of river sections where the water temperature in the upper or middle reaches is already above 0℃ and thawing has begun, while the downstream is still below 0℃ and the river channel has ice blockage. The area near Yi is overall relatively warm and is not the place most prone to ice blockage; the area near Ding is already clearly below 0℃ and is not the key position of positive-negative temperature transition. In the figure, the transitional position where water temperature changes from positive temperature to negative temperature is near Bing, so the river section most likely to have an ice flood is the river section near Bing.

method.method_draft: 先描述右图中的水温曲线：找出哪些河段在0°C以上、哪些河段在0°C以下。再用凌汛发生条件判断：不是选择全段已暖的乙，也不是选择已明显低于0°C的丁，而应选水温从中游正温转向下游负温、最容易发生冰塞的过渡位置。该过渡点在图中标为丙附近，因此答案为丙附近河段。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：右图是“某月叶尼塞河河水水温的变化曲线”，横轴从左到右表示上游、中游、下游，纵轴标有5℃、0℃、-5℃，虚线为0℃。曲线在上游甲附近接近0℃，到乙附近升到0℃以上且较高；之后向中游、下游方向下降，在丙附近接近并由0℃以上转向0℃以下；到丁附近已明显低于0℃。
推理：凌汛最容易发生在上游或中游水温已在0℃以上、开始解冻，而下游仍低于0℃、河道有冰阻塞的河段交界处。乙附近整体偏暖，不是最易冰塞处；丁附近已明显低于0℃，不是正负温转换的关键位置。图中水温由正温转为负温的过渡位置在丙附近，因此最可能出现凌汛的是丙附近河段。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the left map as the Yenisei River system flowing northward toward the Arctic Ocean, with upstream in the south and downstream in the north. Read the right graph as showing water temperature decreasing toward the 下游, with lower reaches near 丁 below 0°C and the transition from warmer middle reaches to colder lower reaches near 丙.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: In Northern Hemisphere rivers flowing from lower latitude to higher latitude, the downstream/northern reach freezes earlier and thaws later, so flowing water or broken ice from warmer upstream/midstream sections is blocked near the boundary with the colder frozen downstream section, producing 凌汛.
